subject: General Knowledge
description: Reports, acts, surveys (Economic Survey, Census, Budget, NSSO)

questions.stem: The ANNUAL ECONOMIC SURVEY of India is prepared by:

options.option_text: Chief Economic Adviser, Ministry of Finance

questions.explanation: Economic Survey — prepared by the Economic Division of the Department of Economic Affairs, Finance Ministry, under the guidance of the Chief Economic Adviser. Laid in Parliament ONE DAY BEFORE the Budget (usually late January).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: India's first CENSUS was conducted in:
questions.explanation: First NON-SYNCHRONOUS census: 1872 (Viceroy Mayo). First SYNCHRONOUS (regular, decennial): 1881 (Lord Ripon). Conducted every 10 years; the 2021 Census was postponed due to covid and is still pending (as of 2026). Registrar General conducts it. under Lord Mayo.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The Union BUDGET presentation schedule was CHANGED to 1st February from 2017 onwards by:
questions.explanation: Arun Jaitley presented the 2017 Union Budget on 1 February (not the traditional last working day of February). Also merged Railway Budget into Union Budget (ending 92-year-old separate presentation). Shift intended to give the fiscal year a head-start before 1 April. Modi government.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The PLI (Production-Linked Incentive) scheme, launched in 2020, is primarily intended to:

options.option_text: Boost domestic manufacturing and exports in key sectors

questions.explanation: PLI — launched April 2020 initially for 3 sectors, expanded to 14 (mobile phones, pharma, auto, steel, electronics, food products, textiles, solar etc.). Gives firms financial incentive on INCREMENTAL SALES over a base year — essentially a subsidy for scaling up Indian manufacturing capacity.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The HUMAN DEVELOPMENT INDEX (HDI) is published annually by:
questions.explanation: HDI — developed by Mahbub-ul-Haq and Amartya Sen, published annually by UNDP. Composite index of life expectancy + education (mean/expected years of schooling) + GNI per capita (PPP). Scale 0-1. India's HDI rank typically 130s-140s range. United Nations Development Programme.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The 'EASE OF DOING BUSINESS' rankings were published by the World Bank. Which year's report was the LAST before discontinuation (2021)?
questions.explanation: World Bank DISCONTINUED the Ease of Doing Business report in September 2021 (following data-integrity concerns). Last report: DB 2020, in which India ranked 63rd (up from 142nd in 2014). The B-READY (Business Ready) initiative is the successor, first launched in 2024.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The 'GLOBAL HUNGER INDEX' is published by:
questions.explanation: Global Hunger Index — annual report by Concern Worldwide (Ireland) + Welthungerhilfe (Germany). Not an official FAO/UN index. India has contested the methodology and ranking. Score based on undernourishment, child wasting, child stunting, child mortality. NGO publication.
